description:

VISION Stage 2 'repository bootstrapping' and the product profile 'support exceptionally well: new repository creation'. Re-measured 2026-09-04: a project must already be an initialized directory (`moe init <dir>` / manager Create writes moe.config.json) and `project.bind_repository` binds an EXISTING git repository; there is no scaffold generator and no GitHub repository creation path (`grep -rc "repo create" apps/ tools/` = 0).

FEATURE: 'New product from PRD' in the browser: directory (new or empty), PRD file, product name, optional GitHub owner/visibility. The daemon runs `repository.bootstrap` (operator-only): `git init`; writes the CONTROLLED-PROFILE scaffold (TypeScript; React + Vite web; Node API; PostgreSQL via docker-compose; vitest; Playwright; pnpm workspace; GitHub Actions CI running `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`; `.env.example`; README with the product name); first commit 'chore: scaffold by Moe'; optional `gh repo create <owner>/<name> --<visibility> --source . --push`; then binds it as the project repository (`project.bind_repository`) and registers it in the manager catalog; receipt `moe-bootstrap-receipt/1` {dir, sha, remoteUrl|null, BOOTSTRAPPED|REFUSED(code)}. The scaffold generator is deterministic and pinned by a profile version constant (golden tree) so every product starts identical. The goal is then created with the PRD (`goal.create_with_source`) and the existing lane continues.

Refusals: BOOTSTRAP_DIR_NOT_EMPTY, BOOTSTRAP_GIT_UNAVAILABLE, BOOTSTRAP_GH_UNAVAILABLE (GitHub is optional - a local-only bootstrap still succeeds and says so), BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_VERSION_UNKNOWN.

(a) DESTRUCTIVE PATH — every boundary the step names is closed IN PRODUCTION, not only in tests. localTarget() :72-74 rejects blank, UNC and control-character paths before any fs call and resolve()s, which normalises a TRAILING SEPARATOR. inspectEmpty() :78-82 uses lstatSync not statSync, so `!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink()` refuses a FILE, a SYMLINK and a Windows JUNCTION with BOOTSTRAP_DIR_INVALID/DIRECTORY_INVALID; `readdirSync(dir).length !== 0` counts DOTFILES like any entry, so a directory holding only .gitignore refuses BOOTSTRAP_DIR_NOT_EMPTY. Real arm: repository-bootstrap-ports.test.ts:146, which builds an actual symlinkSync(..., "junction") at :156.
DISCLOSED, NOT CLAIMED: the lstat+readdir+wx sequence is not an OS-atomic guarantee against a hostile process swapping an ANCESTOR directory — the module says so itself at :94-96. No ordinary-symlink-vs-junction distinction and no hostile-race arm exist. Documented v0.1 limitation, consistent with task rail 2 (features only, trusted workspace). Not filed as a row per global rail 21; it belongs to the owning child's hardening note, not to a new evidence row.

(b) PARTIAL BOOTSTRAP — the receipt is honest and local success is never retracted by a remote failure: repository-bootstrap-service.ts:26-32 returns {remoteUrl: null, githubRefusal: <refusal>} and still builds the receipt at :62-68 with outcome "BOOTSTRAPPED" and the repository bound.
THE HALF-SUCCESS IS REAL AND UNRESOLVABLE AT THE PORT: ports.ts:56-57 runs ONE child, `gh repo create <owner>/<name> --<visibility> --source . --push`. One exit code cannot separate "remote created, push failed" from "create failed", so the receipt cannot either. That is exactly why DoD 4's bounded UI correction landed on THIS row — new-product-form.tsx:78-81 now says "The GitHub step did not complete" plus "A repository may already exist under your GitHub account", with code (detail) @ refusedBy retained; its arm asserts the code, the DAEMON_INGRESS layer, the headline, the "may already exist" sentence and `.not.toMatch(/did not happen|was not reached/iu)`. (c) DETERMINISM — no host input reaches the generator. The only matches for new Date/Date./process.env/process.cwd/os./hostname/homedir/Math.random/toLocale across controlled-profile production sources are doc comments asserting the absence, plus process.env occurrences that are STRING LITERALS EMITTED INTO the generated files (package-templates.ts:179,181; root-templates.ts:290) — generated content, not generator input.
